editing.stylesFailed: Could not load editing styles from the server.
editing.dramaticKept_one: 1 dramatic pause was detected and kept – it is part of the moment, not dead air.
editing.dramaticKept_other: {{count}} dramatic pauses were detected and kept – they are part of the moment, not dead air.
editing.stripTitle: Edit strip – the missing areas are dead air that was removed

director.title: The AI editing plan
director.hint: Every decision was saved with its reason. Decisions that were considered but not applied are shown too, with the reason – so you know what the system did and why, not just the result.
director.unimplemented: Categories not planned in this version and not applied: {{list}}.

qa.title: Quality check after rendering
qa.hint: The file is checked after export – length, streams, black frames, freezes, frame sampling, subtitle bounds and audio loudness. An FFmpeg exit code of 0 is not treated as proof.

audio.title: What was done to the audio
audio.hint: Each step ran only when measurement showed it was needed. Audio processing is destructive, so a good source is left as it is.

job.stopBody: The current segment was closed and processing will continue.
job.noEta: There are not enough measurements yet to estimate a finish time. The estimate appears after a few jobs have completed.
job.interestHint: The combined score over time. Highlighted bands are the segments that were cut.
job.noClipsActive: Clips appear here as soon as export starts.
job.noClipsDone: No clips were created in this job.
job.noTranscriptBody: Transcription was turned off in settings, or the model was not available during processing.
job.analysisPending: The analysis has not finished yet.
job.chartLabel: Interest score over the stream, with the cut clips marked
job.logEmpty: No messages. The log is shown live while the job runs.

live.title: Stream capture
live.reconnectingNote: The connection to the stream dropped and a reconnection is being attempted. Material already recorded is safe – {{count}} segments are saved and will not be lost.
live.stopNote: Stopping ends the recording and sends the collected material to transcription, analysis and editing – exactly the same path as an uploaded file.
live.completed: The recording is complete. The material became the job's source and continues to transcription and analysis.
